# ops_workspace (Resource)

A workspace: one Terraform state and its runs. Created empty; templates are added to it in OPS's UI (adding one starts a plan).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An empty workspace; its templates are added in OPS's UI.
resource "ops_workspace" "shop" {
  name            = "shop-prd"
  project_id      = ops_project.prd.id
  drift_detection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 2–63 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, unique across projects; its URL.

### Optional

- `auto_apply` (Boolean) Apply plans without asking for confirmation.
- `drift_detection` (Boolean) A daily drift check (a refresh-only plan, never applied).
- `execution_mode` (String) `remote`: runs on OPS's runners; `local`: the Terraform CLI runs (a `cloud` block), OPS keeps the state.
- `force_delete` (Boolean) Delete the workspace even while its state still manages resources (admins): they stay, unmanaged. Off: deleting such a workspace fails; destroy its resources first.
- `project_id` (String) The project it's in; changing it moves the workspace (operate access on both). Default: the default project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace's id: it stays when the workspace is renamed or moved.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by name or id
terraform import ops_workspace.shop shop-prd
```
